facts.fact: The Burundi Revenue Office (OBR) communiqué says land tax declaration for 2026/2027 must be made online on the UMUTANGAKORI II platform by 30 September 2026.

BDI.note: No statement on who builds or runs the platforms.

facts.fact: The Burundi Revenue Office (OBR) communiqué says land tax is now managed by OBR and its 2026/2027 declaration must be filed online on UMUTANGAKORI II by 30 September 2026, with payments already made taken into account in the system.

BDI.note: Land tax moved to the national revenue office, which holds the declarations; not a local government's own record.

facts.fact: The Office Burundais des Recettes says land tax declarations for 2026/2027 must be made online on its UMUTANGAKORI II platform, and unregistered taxpayers request their tax identification numbers through its e-Kori platform.
